description: This Java source file defines the class IndexOperations, which provides methods for managing MongoDB indices such as creating, dropping, and listing indices within a specified database and collection.

classes.name: IndexOperations
classes.description: Provides index operations such as creation, deletion, and listing of indices for MongoDB collections.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an IndexOperations instance for a given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops a specified index from a collection; does not throw if the index does not exist.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates an index with specified options on a collection, throws if an index with conflicting options exists.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Retrieves all indices on a collection, including the default '_id' index.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves all indices on a collection except the default '_id' index.
